sentence: This project trains an AI streak detector to find satellite streaks in sky images and describe them.
This project builds laboratory activities for analytical chemistry courses that use paper microfluidic materials and cell phone detection of color changes.
This project studies how the plant hormone cytokinin controls meristem function in rice by examining gene expression in individual cells.
This project runs summer research in physics on topics such as dark matter, graphene and radio astronomy imaging.
This project builds computer methods that combine color imaging, hyperspectral imaging and three-dimensional surface measurement to find defects and work out their causes.
This project supports a research conference on in vivo ultrasound imaging, covering topics such as super-resolution imaging and photoacoustic imaging.
This project tries to cool dense positronium, an atom made of an electron and a positron, until it forms a Bose-Einstein condensate.
This project acquires an Orbitrap mass spectrometer that measures isotope ratios in intact molecules to study atmospheric chemistry and co-evolution of oxygen and life.
This project builds six cyber safety modules that bring cybersecurity ideas into an information technology associate degree track.
This project sets up a computing resource that combines artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and data handling for research.
This project tries to create a 3D cluster state of neutral atoms and to detect quantum states of all the atoms in one image.
This project builds a certificate program that teaches how to combine AI and cybersecurity in secure systems for national defense.
This project tests RNA modification enzymes from microbial organisms to find out which RNA molecules each enzyme chemically changes.
This project builds a computer tool that combines physics-based models with machine learning to simulate how landslides and debris flows damage engineered structures.
This project studies more efficient ways to approximate the earth mover metric, a measure of how similar images or text documents are.
This project studies how sociological and ecological processes interact on rangelands, including work on wildlife, soil and cattle production.
